    About Shop Innovator
    We help premium, high-ticket Shopify brands scale by building high-converting sales machines. We are looking for a hands-on Shopify professional who can build polished storefronts, maintain client stores, and manage day-to-day website updates.

     

    About the Role
    This hybrid role combines Shopify front-end development, website maintenance, content management, and direct client support. You will convert Figma designs into code, optimize storefront performance, and serve as a reliable technical point of contact for our clients and internal team.

     

    What You'll Do

    • Shopify Development: Build responsive pages, sections, and OS 2.0 templates using Liquid, HTML5, CSS3, and JS. Convert Figma designs into pixel-perfect code using Git/GitHub workflows.
    • Store Management & Maintenance: Maintain client stores, troubleshoot theme bugs, install/configure apps, manage content updates, and optimize page speed and Core Web Vitals.
    • Client & Team Collaboration: Communicate directly with clients via email and calls (5–10 calls/month) to explain technical solutions, gather requirements, and manage task updates in ClickUp.

    • CRO & Marketing Support: Build landing pages, add conversion elements (reviews, trust badges, FAQs), and configure third-party tools like Klaviyo, Judge.me, GA4, and Meta Pixel.

       

    What We're Looking For

    • At least three years of professional Shopify development or website-management experience.
    • Strong knowledge of Shopify Liquid.
    • Strong HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript skills.
    • Experience with Shopify Online Store 2.0.
    • Experience creating reusable Shopify sections, blocks, and templates.
    • Experience converting Figma designs into responsive Shopify pages.
    • Experience with Git and GitHub.
    • Experience installing and configuring Shopify apps.
    • Experience managing products, collections, pages, blogs, navigation, and website content.
    • Working knowledge of ecommerce SEO and on-page optimization.
    • Strong understanding of responsive web development.
    • Excellent attention to visual detail.
    • Strong written communication skills.

    • Ability to produce accurate, polished work with minimal supervision.

       

    Who You Are

    You’re someone who:

    • Loves working with Shopify.
    • Is reliable, responsive, and dependable.
    • Works quickly without sacrificing accuracy.
    • Notices UX, content, and visual issues before anyone else.
    • Has a strong eye for design, spacing, consistency, and presentation.
    • Thinks beyond writing code and considers the full customer experience.
    • Understands that premium products require trust-building content and thoughtful presentation.
    • Enjoys solving problems independently.
    • Is highly organized and communicates clearly.
    • Takes ownership of projects from assignment through testing and deployment.
    • Tests everything before marking a task complete.
    • Can comfortably manage multiple client projects and priorities.
    • Collaborates well with designers, marketers, project managers, and clients.
    • Is comfortable asking questions when requirements are unclear.
    • Looks for ways to improve a page instead of simply completing the requested update.

    Bonus Points

    Experience with any of the following would be an asset: Shopify Markets, Shopify Flow, Shopify Functions, Checkout UI Extensions, Metafields and metaobjects, Klaviyo, Judge.me, Shopify Search & Discovery, GA4 and Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, Schema markup, Core Web Vitals optimization, Accessibility and WCAG standards, Conversion rate optimization, A/B testing platforms, Image and video editing tools, AI coding assistants such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or ChatGPT.

     

    Schedule: Remote with required 3–4 hours of daily overlap with 10 AM – 5 PM EST.

     

    Why Join Shop Innovator?

    • Work with premium ecommerce brands rather than commodity products.
    • Build websites that directly contribute to business growth.
    • Be part of a small, experienced, and collaborative team.
    • Work on a variety of interesting Shopify projects.
    • Develop your knowledge of high-ticket ecommerce, UX, CRO, and customer buying psychology.
    • Learn from experienced ecommerce strategists, designers, developers, and marketers.
    • Enjoy flexible remote working hours.
    • Grow with the agency as we expand.

     

    Ready to build high-converting Shopify experiences with us? Click Apply Now to submit your application!

    We are looking for a senior frontend engineer to build high-performance 3D scientific visualization directly in the browser.

    You will work at the intersection of frontend engineering, GPU programming, and large-scale data visualization. The core challenge is making complex 3D and time-varying datasets interactive in the browser without requiring users to download or fully load them first.

     

    What you will do

    • Build browser-based 3D visualization using TypeScript and WebGPU.
    • Render large meshes, point clouds, volumetric fields, and other scientific data.
    • Integrate visualization with asynchronous and random-access data streaming.
    • Design efficient GPU buffer management, caching, and incremental scene updates.
    • Build React-based UI around the visualization experience.
    • Profile and optimize CPU, GPU, memory, and network performance.

    • Work closely with systems, backend, and GPU engineers on end-to-end data delivery.

       

    What we are looking for

    • Strong production experience with TypeScript / JavaScript.
    • Practical experience with WebGPU, or deep WebGL experience with an interest in moving to WebGPU.
    • Strong understanding of performance optimization in browser applications.
    • Experience with React or another modern frontend framework.
    • Good knowledge of vector math, coordinate systems, cameras, transforms, and spatial data structures.

     

    Nice to have

    • Experience with Three.js, Babylon.js, vtk.js, React Three Fiber, or custom rendering engines.
    • WGSL, GLSL, CUDA, Vulkan, DirectX, or Metal experience.
    • Scientific visualization experience with ParaView, VTK, VisIt, or similar tools.
    • Volume rendering, isosurfaces, unstructured meshes, point clouds, particles, or large geometry.
    • LOD systems, spatial partitioning, octrees, BVHs, or GPU-driven rendering.
    • Background in CAD, simulation, geospatial, medical imaging, games, or visualization software.

    As a Shopify Technical Specialist, you will be responsible for configuring, optimizing, and maintaining our Shopify store to ensure smooth operations and an excellent user experience.
     

    You will play a key role in store setup, technical improvements, and UX optimization, helping us scale our e-commerce operations efficiently.
     

    Expect diverse technical challenges, cross-functional collaboration, and opportunities to grow your Shopify expertise while working with a fast-growing brand.
     

    Who We’re Looking For
     

    - Structured Approach
    You can organize processes and keep operations under control.


    - Technical Expertise
    You have strong hands-on experience with Shopify, including store setup, theme customization, integrations, and technical optimization.

    You are comfortable working with Liquid, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript and can independently handle technical changes and troubleshoot Shopify issues.

    Experience with GA4, GTM, Triple Whale, Recharge, Klaviyo, Zendesk, or BigQuery is a strong advantage.


    - Proactive Mindset
    You don't wait for instructions - you identify problems and implement effective solutions independently.


    - Results-Oriented
    You focus on ensuring the website runs smoothly, efficiently, and maximizes conversions.


    - Attention to Detail
    You notice small details, work with precise data, and constantly look for ways to improve processes.

    Marketing & Promotions

    • Implement SEO optimizations

    • Support email marketing automation
    • Set up and monitor promotions
    • Collect reviews and UGC

    Technical Maintenance

    • Monitor website performance and updates
    • Maintain security and integrations
    • Manage backups

    Analytics & Reporting

    • Track sales, conversions, and KPIs
    • Analyze ad campaigns and promotions
    • Prepare reports

    Collaboration with Teams & Partners

    • Work with marketing, logistics, and accounting teams
    • Coordinate with agencies, freelancers, and suppliers

    Documentation & SOPs

    • Develop and maintain SOPs

    We are building a revolutionary AI-based image and video processing platform and are looking for an Integrations Engineer to help expand our customer base through your technical expertise. We are open to candidates who can contribute significantly to developing our solutions and improving the customer experience.

    ​

    Role Overview
    ​The responsibilities of a Solutions Engineer include sharing expertise on the product and its integration—specifically focusing on front-end understanding and a strong overall grasp of web technologies. You will use your analytical and interpersonal skills to guide our clients and maximize the value they gain from using our technology.
     

    ​The ideal candidate should have excellent communication and interpersonal skills, as well as the ability to meet KPIs and deadlines, demonstrating strong analytical abilities.

     

     

    ​Key Responsibilities

    • Be the Product Expert: Act as the product expert and trusted advisor that clients can turn to for guidance on maximizing value from our technology.
    • Expand Technical Expertise: Gain experience in front-end and back-end development, web optimization, performance best practices, AI/ML, cloud computing, media compression, and CDN.
    • Support & Troubleshoot: Support customers’ technical queries, solve integration issues, and demonstrate the possibilities of the technology.
    • Onboard Customers: Manage the technical onboarding of new customers and translate their desired outcomes into an implementation plan that will provide value.
    • Define Requirements: Define new technical requirements for integration and prioritize project timelines.
    • Cross-functional Collaboration: Ensure all customer requests and issues are handled promptly, working in collaboration with relevant teams including Customer Success, R&D, Sales, and Marketing.
    • Quality Assurance: Utilize QA practices to ensure high-quality integrations

     

    Requirements

    • Language Proficiency: Strictly C1-C2 English level required.

      Candidates at an Upper-Intermediate (B1-B2) level will not be considered. Exceptional written and verbal presentation skills are a must.

    • Working Hours: High flexibility and ability to operate within the US time zone.
       

    ​Technical Skills:

    • 5+ years of experience as a Solutions Engineer, Front-End professional, or in QA within a global, fast-paced environment.
    • Experience with Full-Stack technologies (e.g.,Node.js, React, Angular) or QA skills (e.g., automated testing, performance testing).
    • ​Hands-on experience with web and cloud technologies.
    • Experience with basic debugging/QA tools (e.g., Chrome Dev Tools).
    • Problem Solving: Ability to effectively assess and quickly resolve technical issues while working with both technical and non-technical teams. High-level technical, project, and problem-solving skills.

    • Mindset: Strong critical thinking and analytical skills with an entrepreneurial, proactive, and result-oriented mindset. Highly motivated, a fast learner, and open-minded.

       

    Nice to Have​

    • BS, BA, BEng degree or equivalent in Computer Science or a related field.
    • ​Experience with Full-Stack technologies (e.g., Node.js, React, Angular) or automated/performance QA testing skills.
    • ​Relevant certifications, courses, or experience in adjacent technologies.

     

    We OFFER:

    • ​A fast-paced, highly professional, international team environment with a flat structure and rapid decision-making.
    • ​Competitive compensation packages commensurate with your background and product portfolio.
    • ​Flexible, remote-first workflow optimized for seamless global alignment.
    • Medical Insurance in Ukraine and a Multisport program in Poland.
    • Offices in Ukraine (Kyiv, Kharkiv) and Poland (Wroclaw) or Remote.
    • Paid vacation, sick leave, and official holidays.
    • Legal & Accounting services.
    • The company provides all necessary equipment.
    • English classes and Education reimbursement.
